lanes.source_family: Ministry of Energy statements as carried by SPA (spa.gov.sa; moenergy.gov.sa), reached through Saudi outlets republishing them
registry: Ministry of Energy statements (Saudi Press Agency)
lanes.finding: SPA search and index pages returned HTTP 403 to ordinary access in this pass, so whether they are script-rendered could not be observed (iteration 17 saw a script-rendered shell at the same search address). No circumvention was attempted.
lanes.limitation: Nothing was searched or read in this pass: all ten declared queries were refused by the shared search limit (five attempted, none performed), and SPA (HTTP 403) and the ministry site (no response) refused ordinary access once each. The four English year queries for 2022-2025 have still never been run in any pass.

lanes.source_family: Saudi Aramco disclosures: Tadawul announcements; aramco.com news and annual-report incident statements
lanes.finding: All four annual reports (FY2022-FY2025) were read in English. No report mentions the March 2022 YASREF event already in the corpus, or any fire, unplanned shutdown, force majeure or production shut-in in 2022-2025. The other dated incidents named are outside the window (2019, 2021). The FY2025 report's events-after-the-reporting-period note lists only financing and a share repurchase. Aramco annual reports are therefore not an incident source for this window.
lanes.limitation: The Tadawul announcement list refused access (HTTP 403) and was not read; neither declared query ran (shared search limit); the Arabic annual reports were not read (English editions only). Aramco's 2026 interim reports and results releases were deliberately not opened: they are outside the declared 2022-2025 annual-report universe and would carry current operating information during the active campaign.

lanes.source_family: GASTAT and JODI production releases (production effects explicitly attributed to a disruption)
lanes.finding: GASTAT does not attribute production changes to a disruption in the releases read. JODI-Oil publishes a numeric database with definitions, a manual and availability footnotes only; the pages opened carry no narrative attribution.
lanes.limitation: Only two monthly IPI release PDFs were read in full (March and April 2026, English), so no continuous span is covered and covered_through is null. The 2022-2025 monthly releases, the Arabic editions and GASTAT's petroleum-and-gas statistics were not read, and the search listing did not show a complete 2022-2025 series on the pages opened. JODI's Saudi metadata page was not reached.

lanes.source_family: OPEC Monthly Oil Market Report archive
lanes.limitation: All three official OPEC addresses tried (current page, the MOMR download host, the legacy publications page) refused automated access with HTTP 402. No issue was read and no workaround was attempted; the lane needs a person to open the PDFs in a browser.
